name: Rytr
summary: AI relationship manager that briefs you on clients, prepares meetings and drafts follow-ups; also writes content.
description: Rytr now presents itself as an AI relationship manager for professionals. It gathers client context from Gmail, Slack, calendars and meeting notes into a daily brief, prepares meetings, tracks commitments and drafts follow-ups. Its original writing assistant remains, with more than 40 use cases in over 30 languages. The Free plan includes 10,000 characters per month; Lite costs $9 per month.

howToUse.title: Open Rytr
howToUse.description: Open Rytr and sign in. The relationship manager gathers client context for professionals.

howToUse.title: Read the daily brief
howToUse.description: Connect Gmail, Slack and the calendars, then open the daily brief that holds meeting notes. Rytr prepares your meetings, tracks commitments and drafts each follow-up. Nothing is sent until you review it.

howToUse.title: Keep the writing assistant
howToUse.description: When you still need copy, open the original writing assistant. It remains, with use cases in many languages.

features_fr: Un gestionnaire de relations IA qui vous briefe sur les clients, prépare les réunions et rédige les suivis ; rédige également du contenu.
Rytr se présente désormais comme un gestionnaire de relation IA pour les professionnels.
Il rassemble le contexte client de Gmail, Slack, les calendriers et les notes de réunion dans un brief quotidien, prépare les réunions, suit les engagements et rédige les suivis.
Son assistant d'écriture d'origine demeure, avec plus de 40 cas d'utilisation dans plus de 30 langues.
